title: Gene
description: A discrete unit of inheritance which affects one or more biological traits (Source: [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gene](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gene)). Examples include FOXP2 (Forkhead box protein P2), SCARNA21 (small Cajal body-specific RNA 21), A- (agouti genotype).

type.title: Type
type.description: The RDF type(s) of this item.

alternativeOf.title: Alternative Of
alternativeOf.description: Another gene which is a variation of this one.

encodesBioChemEntity.title: Encodes Bio Chem Entity
encodesBioChemEntity.description: Another BioChemEntity encoded by this one.

expressedIn.title: Expressed In
expressedIn.description: Tissue, organ, biological sample, etc in which activity of this gene has been observed experimentally. For example brain, digestive system.

hasBioPolymerSequence.title: Has Bio Polymer Sequence
hasBioPolymerSequence.description: A symbolic representation of a BioChemEntity. For example, a nucleotide sequence of a Gene or an amino acid sequence of a Protein.
